name: member-copy-overwrite

name: output-copy
source: struct O{float4 p:POSITION;float4 a[2]:TEXCOORD0;};O main(float4 t:POSITION){O o;O q;o.p=t;o.a[0]=t;q.p=t;q.a[0]=t*2;o=q;return o;}
